decisions.reason: The devore decoration fabric sits close to the firm's established decorative collection, so management can read sales and feedback and refine the variants, though fashion-driven collection rotation adds some risk of discontinuation.
The transparent burnout fabric builds directly on existing decorative know-how and the firm's reorder continuity, which favours keeping it, despite the trend-sensitivity of burnout designs.
This burnout decorative fabric is close to the core offer, so the firm can assimilate market feedback through its sampling and service processes and keep improving it.
The velour-like upholstery fabric extends the established upholstery line, where the firm's existing knowledge supports interpreting results and adapting the product.
The flame-retardant plain fabric is a functional staple, demanded for contract and retail use, that builds on existing competencies and suits the firm's in-stock reorder model.
The satin-sheen polyester lining is a basic complement to the made-to-measure sewing offer, rests on established knowledge, and fits a steady stocked assortment.
